title: Testing auto-grid content-fit scenarios via the devenv dashboard tabs and Playwright
answers: how to add an e2e test for auto grid content fit
where are the auto grid content fit test dashboards
playwright test for panel height in auto grid
body:
Content-fit behaviors are covered by one devenv dashboard, devenv/dev-dashboards/dashboard-auto-grid/content-fit-scenarios.json, which has one TabsLayoutTab per scenario (e.g. '8. Row packs to short panel'). Panels are defined in `elements` (panel-N) and referenced from the tab's AutoGridLayout items.
To add a scenario: add the panels and a new tab with the layout settings (fitContent, minHeightMode/minHeight, matchRowHeights, rowHeightMode). Then add a test in e2e-playwright/dashboard-new-layouts/dashboards-auto-grid-content-fit.spec.ts that does `tabs.select(<tab title>)` and looks panels up by title with `panels.getPanel`.
Assert heights with the spec's expectHeightAt/expectHeightGrewBeyond helpers and HEIGHT_TOLERANCE, since rendered heights can be a border or rounding pixel off. The row gap between grid rows is GRID_ROW_GAP = 8 (theme.spacing(1) in AutoGridLayoutRenderer). Poll boundingBox values with expect.poll.
For the unit side, getAutoRowsTemplate is pure and is tested directly in AutoGridLayoutManager.test.ts. Enable the flag with setTestFlags({ [FlagKeys.GrafanaDashboardsAutoHeightPanels]: true }).
applies: Writing tests for dashboard auto-grid content-fit / min-max height behavior
